prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Finish new screen changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests (+1.0% average after noise correction).
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, and sign_in hint changes, as each has only 1 test so far.
No kind of change has been shown to be helpful yet, as all tests so far resulted in no clear effect.
Predictions were consistently too high across all tests, particularly for redesigns (predicted +12.0%, measured -3.4%) and new flows (predicted +2.0%, measured -4.6%).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, redesign: -1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: -2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: +1.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Safeguard Hint: Displays a reassurance hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that existing pet data is bound to your account so progress won't be lost. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet Care Basics Checklist: Adds a pet care checklist screen right at the finish stage introducing how to feed, hide, and interact with the desktop pet. (why: Users reported confusion after onboarding on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet (3 emails).)
2: [adoption, hint] Photo Generation Error Prevention Hint: Adds a guidance hint on photo upload detailing clear lighting and face visibility requirements to reduce pet generation failures. (why: Support received 3 emails about custom pet generation failing or looking incorrect.)
3: [finish, redesign] Desktop Visibility Status Check: Redesigns the home intro screen into a split layout featuring a direct desktop visibility verification button. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on desktop or app failing to display after completing setup.)
4: [home, notification] Pet Hatching Status Notification: Enables desktop notification toggle and clear status messaging on the waiting screen while the pet is being generated. (why: The home step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s leading to drop-off while waiting.)
5: [choose_path, redesign] Choice Story Scroll Redesign: Redesigns the choose path screen layout to story_scroll format with structured pet selection choice cards. (why: Choose path screen has a mean time of 514s and 76.2% conversion, indicating hesitation.)
6: [home, new_flow] Waiting Screen Tip Carousel Flow: Adds interactive tip carousel components and time estimate indicators to the waiting screen during pet generation. (why: Waiting screen has high drop-off and very long average wait times (mean 2336s).)
7: [choose_path, redesign] Path Story Intro Card Redesign: Redesigns the story screen using a card layout with step counters to orient new users. (why: Story screen entry point has 76.2% conversion and users spend up to 514s on average.)

scores.note: Target step loses 27.1% and support evidence is strongest (8 emails). Low-cost hint change.
Finish loses 35.2% of users. Previous finish new_screen tests averaged +1.0%, though cost is high.
Adoption step has the highest drop-off (39.1%). Hint change is config-only with reasonable evidence.
High drop-off step with support emails, but redesigns previously underperformed target expectations.
Addresses high wait time at home step, though home step drop-off is relatively low (18.7%).
Targets choose_path hesitation, but redesign changes have weak/negative historical evidence.
Addresses home wait times with interactive flow, but new_flow showed negative historical lift (-2.0%).
Redesign aimed at initial screen drop-off; low historical confidence for redesign formats.
